## Claims
- [source-backed] \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(q=n-r\), where \(I_{r,q}\) is spanned integrally by \(s_\lambda\) with \(\lambda\nsubseteq q^r\); truncated Schur multiplication is integral. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 207-218; 263-269]
- [source-backed] For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(i=s-t+1,\ j=r-t+1\), and \(a=\min(q-i,r-j),\ b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- [proved] Partition conjugation induces an integral graded algebra isomorphism
  \[
  \omega_{r,q}:A_{r,q}:=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{q,r},
  \qquad \bar s_\lambda\mapsto\bar s_{\lambda'},
  \]
  with inverse \(\omega_{q,r}\).
- [proved] Under the Grassmannian interval presentation
  \[
  J_v=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda,
  \]
  one has \(\omega_{r,q}(J_v)=J_{v^\vee}\), where
  \[
  v^\vee=v_{q,\ q+j-i,\ q-i+1,\ n},
  \quad (i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b).
  \]
- [proved] Conjugation preserves positive degree and hence descends integrally to
  \[
  J_v/A_{r,q,+}J_v\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\
  J_{v^\vee}/A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee}.
  \]
  It preserves every partition-weight degree, all torsion orders, and degreewise free ranks.

## Strategy
Let \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\), a ring involution. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 484-485] Since
\[
\lambda\nsubseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\nsubseteq r^q,
\]
\(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\), proving quotient well-definedness and the inverse statement.

For the parameter check, original bigrassmannian admissibility gives
\[
1\le i\le q,\qquad1\le j\le r.
\]
Thus \(t^\vee=q-i+1\) and \(s^\vee=q+j-i\) satisfy
\[
1\le t^\vee\le q,\quad t^\vee\le s^\vee\le n,\quad
t^\vee-(q+s^\vee-n)=r-j+1>0.
\]
Direct substitution gives \((i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b)\).

Conjugation sends \(\lambda\supseteq i^j\) exactly to \(\lambda'\supseteq j^i\), so it carries the interval ideal for \(v\) to that for \(v^\vee\). Since \(|\lambda'|=|\lambda|\), it maps \(A_+\) onto \(A^\vee_+\), yielding the displayed quotient isomorphism. Its Schur-coordinate matrix is a permutation matrix over \(\mathbb Z\), so no rationalization or torsion-freeness assumption is used.

Boundary cases are included: \(r,q\ge1\); \(i=q\) or \(j=r\) forces \(a=0\) when appropriate, and then both interval families have the single core shape. Also \(b=\min(i,j)\ge1\), while \(j-b\) and \(i-b\) may be \(0\); the corresponding zero-part conventions cause no exception.

The requested quotient-conjugation target is established. No unsupported premise was encountered, so no repair certificate is required. No \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) finite transition computation was used.
